droidvisx.language.description: Droid interface language. Takes effect immediately; messages, code and model output keep their original language.
droidvisx.runtime.mode.description: How the extension runs Droid sessions. Changing this requires a window reload. Daemon is strict by default; per-window subprocesses are used only when Process is explicitly selected.
droidvisx.runtime.mode.enum.0: Each window runs its own droid subprocess.
droidvisx.runtime.mode.enum.1: Sessions run over a persistent local droid daemon connection, so tasks survive window reloads (default).
droidvisx.browserDev.sourceRoot.descript: Absolute path to the Droid source repository used by the Browser Dev Client. Development hosts fall back to their extension source path.
droidvisx.theme.description: Color theme for the Droid panel. Takes effect immediately.
droidvisx.theme.enum.1: Always use the warm light theme.
droidvisx.reviewQuestion.modelId.descrip: Model for inline questions in Review Changes. Leave empty to follow the main chat. Configure this in Droid Management > General > Code review questions.
droidvisx.modelSource.description: Model sources shown in Droid model selectors. Takes effect immediately and does not change the active model.
droidvisx.modelSource.enum.1: Show custom models configured with your own API keys.
droidvisx.modelSource.enum.2: Show both Factory-managed and custom models (default).
droidvisx.autocomplete.enabled.descripti: Enable editor gray-text completions. Sends bounded cursor context and, when enabled, relevant workspace snippets to the configured provider. Independent of Droid chat; requires a trusted workspace.
droidvisx.autocomplete.endpoint.descript: Complete FIM, SiliconFlow, Ollama or Mercury Next Edit endpoint URL. Service presets store API keys in SecretStorage.
droidvisx.autocomplete.model.description: FIM-capable model ID on the configured provider. Independent of the chat model.
droidvisx.autocomplete.debounceMs.descri: Wait after typing before requesting a completion. Manual requests skip this wait.
droidvisx.autocomplete.maxContextCharact: Maximum UTF-16 text units in the complete request: current-file prefix/suffix plus related snippets and their headers.
droidvisx.autocomplete.maxTokens.descrip: Maximum number of generated completion tokens per request.
droidvisx.autocomplete.excludePatterns.d: Glob patterns excluded from completion context. Related files also respect workspace .gitignore and .droidignore. Clipboard and chat history are never read.
droidvisx.autocomplete.protocol.descript: Wire protocol for the configured model: ordinary FIM or Mercury Next Edit. Use the service preset to configure a compatible endpoint and model.
droidvisx.autocomplete.protocol.enum.0: Native FIM endpoint using prompt and suffix with an SSE response.
droidvisx.autocomplete.protocol.enum.1: Ollama /api/generate using prompt and suffix with an NDJSON response.
droidvisx.autocomplete.protocol.enum.2: SiliconFlow prefix/suffix FIM extension on /v1/chat/completions with an SSE response.
droidvisx.autocomplete.protocol.enum.3: Mercury Next Edit: predict replacements using editable regions and recent edit history.
droidvisx.autocomplete.relatedFiles.desc: Include bounded snippets from definitions, recent edits and open files in the same workspace folder. Respects .gitignore, .droidignore and exclusions. Disable for current-file-only context.
Adapt the typing delay to recent response latency (150-1000 ms). Disable to use debounceMs.
Opt in to including up to 4000 characters of clipboard text in ordinary completion context. Sent to the configured provider. Disabled by default.
droidvisx.autocomplete.staticContext.des: Use Kilo static syntax context analysis in addition to imports, recent edits and viewed files. Requires relatedFiles.
droidvisx.autocomplete.autoTrigger.descr: Request suggestions automatically while typing. Disable to use Droid: Request Code Completion manually.
droidvisx.autocomplete.snoozeUntil.descr: Pause automatic suggestions until this Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Set from the Droid Tab status menu.
